name: mod-wrap-up
description: Wrap up: hand off to a fresh session (summarize, /clear, fill the handoff) or fill a /compact that keeps what you pick

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait. Hover colors also fade. Off, everything draws still

max_words.title: Handoff length (words)
max_words.description: Most words the handoff may use. A hard cap on the message the model writes

pick_threads.title: Read the threads
pick_threads.description: Haiku finds up to four threads. You keep or drop each one when the card opens. Off, the card shows only the fixed items and the whole session counts

auto_handoff.title: Automatic handoff
auto_handoff.description: Keeps a handoff ready each turn. After a turn, Sonnet updates a ledger of decisions and tasks and a fresh handoff in the background. /compact is given the handoff, and the next prompt after a compaction or a related /clear carries it. Off (the default), the mod makes no background model call and only the Wrap up pill hands off

auto_every.title: Update every (turns)
auto_every.description: Turns between handoff updates. At least 1

auto_compact.title: Auto handoff at the mark
auto_compact.description: Clears and hands off at the mark. Once either mark below is reached, a 5 second countdown card appears between turns. Unless you cancel, type a draft or start a turn, the ledger is brought up to date, the chat is cleared and Claude continues the open task from the handoff (with no open task, the handoff is filled into the prompt instead). Meant for sessions with Claude Code's own auto-compact off. Needs Automatic handoff on

compact_at.title: Hand off at (%)
compact_at.description: Context % that starts the countdown. Guards small windows; the token mark comes first on large ones

compact_at_tokens.title: Hand off at (tokens)
compact_at_tokens.description: Tokens that start the countdown. Whichever mark comes first, tokens or percent, starts it

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when the terminal's font is a Nerd Font (read from Windows Terminal, iTerm2, VS Code, Ghostty, kitty, WezTerm, Alacritty, GNOME Terminal or Konsole) and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
